name: vastblast-simple-terminal-controls
description: Status bar controls for common terminal workflows in VS Code.

commands.title: Simple Terminal Controls: Set Terminal Path Mode

simpleTerminalControls.preferActiveTermi.description: Use the active terminal when one exists. When disabled, commands use a dedicated Simple Terminal Controls terminal.

simpleTerminalControls.enableDefaultRunC.description: Enable built-in single-file run commands. Disable this when you want simpleTerminalControls.runCommands to be the only source of run behavior.

simpleTerminalControls.autoDetectRuntime.description: Detect relevant runtime commands lazily and cache the result. Project-local TypeScript runners are checked before PATH commands.

simpleTerminalControls.stopBehavior.description: How the Reset button handles the active terminal.

simpleTerminalControls.statusBarPriority.description: Status bar priority for the CD button. Run and Stop are placed immediately to its left. Lower values move right-aligned items farther right.

run.description: Status bar foreground color for Run.

stop.description: Status bar foreground color for Stop.

cd.description: Status bar foreground color for CD.

simpleTerminalControls.colors.description: Status bar foreground colors for the controls.

simpleTerminalControls.pathStyle.description: How file paths are formatted before sending commands. Auto detects WSL-like Windows terminals.

simpleTerminalControls.terminalName.description: Name for the dedicated terminal when simpleTerminalControls.preferActiveTerminal is disabled or no terminal is active.

simpleTerminalControls.tools.description: Override tool command names used by built-in defaults.

simpleTerminalControls.runCommands.description: Custom run commands keyed by basename, extension, *.extension, extension without the dot, language id, folder, or default. Templates support ${file}, ${runFile}, ${fileRaw}, ${fileDirname}, ${folder}, ${workspaceFolder}, ${relativeFile}, ${fileBasename}, ${fileBasenameNoExtension}, and raw variants.

scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run lint && node --test out/test/*.test.js
